title: How I AI: Fable 5.2 Review + How I fight token fraud as a solo founder + Building a Claude Code family OS
author: Lenny Rachitsky
description: Your weekly listens from How I AI, part of the Lenny's Podcast Network
summary: In this episode, he shows how the system tracks appliances and warranties, compares insurance quotes, organizes family projects, and keeps household tasks moving through a shared to-do list and wall display. He also explains why persistent files work better for him than long AI chats, and how the same philosophy shapes his approach to using AI without taking the thinking away from students.
takeaways: When his own agent goes off track, he starts fresh or investigates its reasoning before incorrect information reaches his memory files.
She walks through six forms of abuse, including farmed free trials, resold promo codes, card testing, product relays, and a custom MCP running as a 24/7 compute worker.
A custom linter prevents verbose agents from bloating documents such as his household to-do list.
